driver_of_the_day.label: +10.0 pts v expected
driver_of_the_day.why: Max Verstappen scored 25 from P1 on the grid; the model expected 15.0.

best_drive_from_back.label: P22 to P10
best_drive_from_back.why: Isack Hadjar gained 12 places from P22 in the 4th-fastest car.

best_strategy.label: +3.4 places through the stops
best_strategy.why: Isack Hadjar's 2-stop race cost 3.4 fewer places in the pit windows than the race's average stop.

fastest_stop.label: 23.5 s in the pit lane
fastest_stop.why: Quickest trip through the pit lane, lap 39 (no stationary times published).

overtake_of_race.label: on Pierre Gasly, lap 58
overtake_of_race.why: Isack Hadjar passed Pierre Gasly for P10 on lap 58 despite being +1.97 s/lap slower on corrected pace.

smoothest.label: 0.364 s lap-time sd
smoothest.why: Nico Hülkenberg's corrected clean laps varied by just 0.364 s (1 sd).

team_of_weekend.label: +8.4 pts v expected
team_of_weekend.why: Red Bull's drivers beat the model's expectation by 8.4 points combined.
